sources.title: Inflect-Micro-v2: Text-to-Audio model — overview, use cases, alternatives
sources.snippet: Overview Inflect-Micro-v2 is a complete text-to-waveform speech synthesis model with 9,356,513 parameters, built by owensong. It generates 24 kHz mono English speech with fixed voice in a 37.53 MB FP32 package that runs on CPU or CUDA. sources.title: Inflect-Micro-v2 — 9.36M-parameter local… | AI/TLDR
sources.snippet: Inflect-Micro-v2 is a 9.36M-parameter English text-to-speech model from indie developer Owen Song. The full FP32 checkpoint is 37.53 MB, small enough to bundle inside a desktop or mobile app, yet it produces natural-sounding 24 kHz mono audio without needing a reference voice at runtime.
